text:
During the 2026-Q1 reporting period, two adverse-event-related quality measures were documented in the supplied structured records.

For SEP-B1, “Sepsis bundle compliance within 3 hours,” the record reports 115 compliant cases out of a denominator of 535, with 41 exclusions. The reported rate is 23.28 percent. The associated event dates listed for this measure are 2026-02-14, 2026-04-08, 2026-08-18, 2026-09-28, and 2026-10-19. This measure reflects documented compliance with the sepsis bundle within the specified 3-hour timeframe for the included cases.

For READM-30, “30-day all-cause readmission rate,” the record reports 188 readmissions out of a denominator of 1325, with 43 exclusions. The reported rate is 14.66 percent. The associated event dates listed for this measure are 2026-01-24, 2026-04-18, 2026-06-19, 2026-07-17, and 2026-11-21. This measure reflects documented all-cause readmissions within the specified 30-day timeframe for the included cases.

Together, the records identify two monitored quality areas during 2026-Q1: timely sepsis bundle compliance and 30-day all-cause readmissions. The source records provide numerators, denominators, exclusions, rates, measure identifiers, measure names, reporting period, units, and event dates for each measure. No source record includes patient-level details, severity classification, causation assessment, preventability determination, benchmark comparison, corrective action, or outcome beyond the reported measure data. Therefore, this summary is limited to the documented measure-level adverse-event information supplied in the structured records.
